description: Call this for general questions about how Kanal Varna works: do you have to break walls, is it a blockage or a leak, do drain chemicals help, is the visit paid if the leak is not found, insurer reports, payment and invoices, prices in advance, areas, hours, how fast you can come, languages. Pass the question (any language) to get the best answers, or omit it to get all FAQs. Each answer has a URL.

language.description: Language of the user's question: 'bg' (Bulgarian), 'en' (English), 'ru' (Russian) or 'de' (German; answers use English labels where no German text exists). If omitted it is detected from the text; default 'bg'.
language.title: Language

question.description: The user's question or topic, e.g. 'трябва ли да се кърти', 'do you give invoices'. Omit for all FAQs.
question.title: Question
